Pistol.

Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 40/120 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d12 + 3) Piercing damage. This magic musket gives a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it, and its scope ignores the Disadvantage normally imposed for attacking at long range.
